wish: someone should make a tool that draws binary protocol figures from a spec
spec:
Draws an RFC-style packet header figure, as SVG and as ASCII art, from a plain list of field names and bit widths.
Type one field per line ("Source Port: 16", "Options: *" for variable length), pick bits per row, then copy the ASCII or download the SVG.
It does not read RFC text, C structs or ASN.1, and it does not decode real packets.

type.text:
Version: 4
IHL: 4
Total Length: 16
Source Address: 32

notes: Fields fill rows left to right; a partial last row is shaded as padding. Fields wider than a row continue across rows with the label on the widest segment.
